_comment: LOOK_AT defaults to the OPPONENT and its 'target' was unread, so "look at the top card of YOUR deck" was looking at the opponent's -- not a dead effect, an information leak pointing the wrong way. The target named a zone but never a player, and the shared target parser refuses to guess one, so the card now says player SELF outright. The bottoming half named NO zone, so it fell through to PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM's hand+arsenal default: activating Seerstone put a card from your HAND and a card from your ARSENAL on the bottom of your deck, mandatorily, instead of the card it had just looked at. A wrong default is more damaging than none. "It" is the looked-at card, so this reads the ref LOOK_AT stores, and "you may" is honoured.
